t: A credit card sized Intel PC with a Raspberry Pi style pin header.
steps: Buy the board from Arace, the Radxa partner store, or a reseller such as Amazon. Pick a memory size.
Get a 12 volt USB-C PD power supply, a heatsink or fan and a 2230 NVMe drive.
Download Ubuntu or Windows 11 installer files and write them to a USB stick.
Connect a screen through micro HDMI, plus a keyboard, a mouse, and the USB stick.
Power on and install the operating system onto the NVMe drive.
Follow the Radxa X4 getting started guide to finish setup.
Install Thonny and flash MicroPython onto the RP2040 using the Radxa docs.
Try the blink example to flash an LED on the 40-pin header.
meta: Open Board. From $60. A few stores.
